2343-the-adventure-of-wisteria-lodge.title: The Adventure of Wisteria Lodge
2343-the-adventure-of-wisteria-lodge.creator: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
2343-the-adventure-of-wisteria-lodge.description: A book by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. "My dear Watson, you know how bored I have been since we locked up Colonel Carruthers. My mind is like a racing engine, tearing itself to pieces because it is not connected up with the work for which it was built. Life is commonplace, the papers are sterile; audacity and romance seem to have passed forever from the criminal world.

arxiv-2110-15693.title: Shortest Beer Path Queries in Outerplanar Graphs Thanks: A preliminary version was presented at the 32nd Annual International Symposium on Algorithms and Computation (ISAAC 2021). JB was supported by an NSERC Undergraduate Student Research Award. MS was suported by NSERC.
arxiv-2110-15693.creator: Joyce Bacic, Saeed Mehrabi, Michiel Smid
arxiv-2110-15693.description: Abstract A beer graph is an undirected graph G G , in which each edge has a positive weight and some vertices have a beer store. A beer path between two vertices u u and v v in G G is any path in G G between u u and v v that visits at least one beer store.

arxiv-2112-03775.title: The quantum UV-IR map for line defects in 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 ​ ( 3 ) \mathfrak{gl}(3) -type class S S theories
arxiv-2112-03775.creator: Andrew Neitzke, and Fei Yan
arxiv-2112-03775.description: Abstract We consider the quantum UV-IR map for line defects in class S S theories of 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 ​ ( 3 ) \mathfrak{gl}(3) -type. This map computes the protected spin character which counts framed BPS states with spin for the bulk-defect system.

arxiv-2112-12258.title: The Wavelength-shifting Optical Module
arxiv-2112-12258.creator: Benjamin Bastian-Querner \orcidK, Lucas S. Binn, Sebastian Böser, Jannes Brostean-Kaiser, Dustin Hebecker, Klaus Helbing, Timo Karg, Lutz Köpke, Marek Kowalski, Peter Peiffer, Anna Pollmann*, John Rack-Helleis \orcidH, Martin Rongen \orcidG, Lea Schlickmann \orcidI, Florian Thomas \orcidJ, Anna Vock
arxiv-2112-12258.description: Abstract The Wavelength-shifting Optical Module (WOM) is a novel photosensor concept for the instrumentation of large detector volumes with single-photon sensitivity. The key objective is to improve the signal-to-noise ratio which is achieved by decoupling the photosensitive area of a sensor from the cathode area of its photomultiplier tube (PMT).

arxiv-2209-01338.title: FedAR+: A Federated Learning Approach to Appliance Recognition with Mislabeled Data in Residential Buildings CCS: Computing methodologies Supervised learning by classification CCS: Hardware Energy metering
arxiv-2209-01338.creator: Ashish Gupta 1 , Hari Prabhat Gupta 2 , and Sajal K. Das 1
arxiv-2209-01338.description: Abstract . With the enhancement of people’s living standards and rapid growth of communication technologies, residential environments are becoming smart and well-connected, increasing overall energy consumption substantially. As household appliances are the primary energy consumers, their recognition becomes crucial to avoid unattended usage, thereby conserving energy and making smart environments more sustainable.

arxiv-2302-02144.title: Global existence for reaction diffusion systems with strict balance Law and nonlinearities with non constant-sign and unlimited polynomial growth . Thanks: This work was supported by the College of Science and Technology, University of Abbes Laghrour Khenchela, project code: C00L03UN400120220001.
arxiv-2302-02144.creator: Said Kouachi
arxiv-2302-02144.description: Abstract . The purpose of this paper is to prove global existence of solutions for general systems of reaction diffusion equations with nonlinearities for which only two main proprieties hold: Quasi-Positivity and balance law but with two difficulties: they change sign and with unlimited polynomial growth.

arxiv-2306-10020.title: The Life and Death of Software Ecosystems
arxiv-2306-10020.creator: Raula Gaikovina Kula, Gregorio Robles
arxiv-2306-10020.description: Abstract Software ecosystems have gained a lot of attention in recent times. Industry and developers gather around technologies and collaborate to their advancement; when the boundaries of such an effort go beyond certain amount of projects, we are witnessing the appearance of Free/Libre and Open Source Software (FLOSS) ecosystems.

arxiv-2312-12533.title: Thermodynamics of black holes with probe D-branes
arxiv-2312-12533.creator: Alejandro Cabo-Bizet, Marina David, Alfredo González Lezcano
arxiv-2312-12533.description: Abstract Understanding how the thermodynamic properties of a black hole are modified when probed by D-branes is an important problem in AdS/CFT. This work focuses on a recently proposed black hole/D3-brane system in AdS 5 × {}_{5}\times S 5 , which is dual to four-dimensional 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}=4 SYM in the presence of a two-dimensional surface defect.

arxiv-2406-10975.title: \nolinenumbers Internally heated convection with rotation: bounds on heat transport
arxiv-2406-10975.creator: \nolinenumbers Ali Arslan
arxiv-2406-10975.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by \nolinenumbers Ali Arslan. \nolinenumbers This work investigates heat transport in rotating internally heated convection, for a horizontally periodic fluid between parallel plates under no-slip and isothermal boundary conditions. The main results are the proof of lower bounds on the mean temperature, ⟨ T ⟩ ¯ \overline{\left\langle T\right\rangle} , and the heat flux out of the bottom boundary, ℱ B \mathcal{F}_{B} , at infinite Prandtl number, where the Prandtl number is the nondimensional ratio of viscous to thermal diffusion.

arxiv-2407-11313.title: Real toric manifolds associated with chordal nestohedra Thanks: This work was supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea Grant funded by the Korean Government (NRF-2021R1A6A1A10044950).
arxiv-2407-11313.creator: Suyoung Choi, Younghan Yoon
arxiv-2407-11313.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Suyoung Choi, Younghan Yoon. This paper investigates the rational Betti numbers of real toric manifolds associated with chordal nestohedra. We consider the poset topology of a specific poset induced from a chordal building set, and show its EL-shellability. Based on this, we present an explicit description using alternating ℬ \mathcal{B} -permutations for a chordal building set ℬ \mathcal{B} , transforming the computing Betti numbers into a counting problem.

arxiv-2410-22764.title: An Evaluation of Massively Parallel Algorithms for DFA Minimization
arxiv-2410-22764.creator: Jan Martens, Anton Wijs
arxiv-2410-22764.description: Abstract We study parallel algorithms for the minimization of Deterministic Finite Automata (DFAs). In particular, we implement four different massively parallel algorithms for DFA minimization on Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). Our results confirm the expectations that the algorithm with the theoretically best time complexity is not practically suitable to run on GPUs due to the large amount of resources needed.

arxiv-2506-14677.title: Human-Centered Editable Speech-to-Sign-Language Generation via Streaming Conformer-Transformer and Resampling Hook
arxiv-2506-14677.creator: Yingchao Li
arxiv-2506-14677.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yingchao Li. Existing end-to-end sign-language animation systems suffer from low naturalness, limited facial/body expressivity, and no user control. We propose a human-centered, real-time speech-to-sign animation framework that integrates (1) a streaming Conformer encoder with an autoregressive Transformer-MDN decoder for synchronized upper-body and facial motion generation, (2) a transparent, editable JSON intermediate representation empowering deaf users and experts to inspect and modify each sign segment, and (3) a human-in-the-loop optimization loop that refines the model based on user edits and ratings.

arxiv-2509-08873.title: In situ estimation of the acoustic surface impedance using simulation-based inference
arxiv-2509-08873.creator: Jonas M. Schmid, Johannes D. Schmid, Martin Eser, Steffen Marburg
arxiv-2509-08873.description: Abstract Accurate acoustic simulations of enclosed spaces require precise boundary conditions, typically expressed through surface impedances for wave-based methods. Conventional measurement techniques often rely on simplifying assumptions about the sound field and mounting conditions, limiting their validity for real-world scenarios.

arxiv-2602-03616.title: On the Influence of Pluto on Twotino Dynamics Through Their Mutual 4:3 Mean Motion Resonance
arxiv-2602-03616.creator: S. Ramírez-Vargas, A. Peimbert, M. A. Muñoz-Gutiérrez ,, A. Perez-Villegas
arxiv-2602-03616.description: Abstract Context. The role of Pluto contributing to the long-term evolution of the trans-Neptunian region has been considered significant only over its neighboring Plutinos. However, it has recently been found that the long-term stability of the Twotino population is strongly affected when including Pluto as a massive object in simulations, while Eris, with a similar mass, has a negligible effect.

europmc-pmc3146901.description: Background Indoor-based anti-vector interventions remain the preferred means of reducing risk of malaria transmission in malaria endemic areas around the world. Despite demonstrated success in reducing human-mosquito interactions, these methods are effective solely against endop

pmc-10576790.title: The effect of sleep deprivation on postural stability among physically active young adults
pmc-10576790.creator: Rafał Stemplewski, Julia Ciążyńska, Magdalena Cyma-Wejchenig, Janusz Maciaszek
pmc-10576790.description: The study aimed to evaluate the effect of sleep deprivation on postural stability among physically active young adults. The study involved 22 physical education students. Average velocities and spatial distribution of the center of pressure displacements were taken as indicators of postural stability (double and one-leg standing). Two-way ANOVA with two factors of repeated measurements—“session” (control-experimental) and “daytime” (evening-morning)—was used.

pmc-10736495.title: GRAY FOR A DAY: A SIMULATION ACTIVITY IMPACTS PARTICIPANTS IN COMMUNITY-BASED HEALTH EDUCATION
pmc-10736495.creator: David Buys, Jasmine Harris-Speight, Pamela Redwine, Ann Sansing, Erin Yelland
pmc-10736495.description: Nearly 80% of older adults own their own homes; approximately two-thirds live within 25 miles of relatives; and most prefer to age-in-place, without access to geriatric-specific care. They rely on primary care clinics and family, friends, and other local support to meet their health needs. The healthcare workforce and lay public need to better understand age-related functional decline.

pmc-11344392.title: Topical bromfenac in VEGF-driven maculopathies: topical review and meta-analysis
pmc-11344392.creator: Alexei N. Kulikov, Alexander S. Vasiliev, Yana A. Kalinicheva, Dmitrii S. Maltsev
pmc-11344392.description: BackgroundTopical non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs have the potential to reduce treatment burden and improve outcomes of anti-VEGF therapy for a number of retinal disorders, including neovascular age-related macular degeneration, diabetic macular edema, and retinal vein occlusions. In this review, we focused on the advantages of topical bromfenac as an adjunct to intravitreal anti-VEGF therapy in VEGF-driven maculopathies.

pmc-11476266.title: Evaluation of Female Recipient Infertility and Donor Spermatogonial Purification for Germ Cell Transplantation in Paralichthys olivaceus
pmc-11476266.creator: Yuqin Ren, Yuehong Tao, Zhaohui Sun, Yufen Wang, Weidong Li, Zhongwei He, Guixing Wang, Yucong Yang, Jilun Hou, Dariusz Kucharczyk
pmc-11476266.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryGerm cell transplantation (GCT) has been widely used in fish breeding and genetic resource conservation. However, the technique of spermatogonial stem cell transplantation (SSCT) using female adults as recipients has not been established in Paralichthys olivaceus. There are two key points of GCT technology, one is the preparation of sterile recipients and the other is obtaining a high proportion of donor germ stem cells.

pmc-11644885.title: Enhancing Steganography Detection with AI: Fine-Tuning a Deep Residual Network for Spread Spectrum Image Steganography
pmc-11644885.creator: Oleksandr Kuznetsov, Emanuele Frontoni, Kyrylo Chernov, Kateryna Kuznetsova, Ruslan Shevchuk, Mikolaj Karpinski
pmc-11644885.description: This paper presents an extensive investigation into the application of artificial intelligence, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), in image steganography detection. We initially evaluated the state-of-the-art steganalysis model, SRNet, on various image steganography techniques, including WOW, HILL, S-UNIWARD, and the innovative Spread Spectrum Image Steganography (SSIS).

pmc-11679399.title: Pesticide Contamination of Honey-Bee-Collected Pollen in the Context of the Landscape Composition in Latvia
pmc-11679399.creator: Niks Ozols, Valters Brusbārdis, Maksims Filipovičs, Jānis Gailis, Vitalijs Radenkovs, Betija Rubene, Viktorija Zagorska, Luis Alberto Henríquez-Hernández
pmc-11679399.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The honey bee (Apis mellifera) is the most widely managed pollinator and is vital for crop fertilization. Recently, bee colonies have been suffering high mortality rates, exacerbated by factors such as land-use changes and the use of pesticides. Our work aimed to explore the residues of pesticides in honey-bee-collected pollen and how this contamination was affected by seasonality and the landscape composition. We selected six apiaries from different landscapes in Latvia, and pollen samples were collected during the flowering season (2023).

pmc-12553788.title: Wastewater concentrations of rotavirus RNA are associated with infection and vaccination metrics in the USA
pmc-12553788.creator: Elana M G Chan, Alessandro Zulli, Alexandria B Boehm
pmc-12553788.description: Surveillance of rotavirus infections remains critical because vaccines are underutilized in the USA. Using wastewater solids measurements of rotavirus RNA collected over one year from 185 wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) in the USA, we inferred spatiotemporal occurrence patterns of rotavirus infections and compared occurrence patterns to clinical metrics of infections and markers of vaccination coverage.

pmc-13037379.title: Facile synthesis of Bi2O3/BiOX mixed-phase for electrochemical detection of paracetamol
pmc-13037379.creator: Raamisa Anjum, Md. Hasanuzzaman, Muhammad Shahriar Bashar, Juliya Khanam, Umme Sarmeen Akhtar, A. M. Sarwaruddin Chowdhury, Samina Ahmed, Sumaya Farhana Kabir, Md. Sahadat Hossain
pmc-13037379.description: In recent times, paracetamol (N-acetyl-p-aminophenol) detection has become crucial due to its widespread clinical use combined with the public health issue of hepatotoxicity from overdose. In this research, mixed-phase Bi2O3/BiOX (X = Cl, Br and I) was synthesized at room temperature in a single-step solid–state reaction and for the first time used in paracetamol detection.

pmc-13138665.title: Optimizing hepatitis B diagnosis for mothers in a low-resource setting: A field pilot of Xpert point-of-care viral load testing in Ugandan antenatal clinics
pmc-13138665.creator: Linda Kisaakye Nabitaka, Viola Kasone, Emmanuel Olal, Judith Kyokushaba, Philip Kasibante, Susan Nambozo, Aidarayaan Namakula, Susan Nabadda Ndidde, Ponsiano Ocama, Isaac Ssewanyana, Mustafa A Barbhuiya, Mustafa A Barbhuiya, Mustafa A Barbhuiya
pmc-13138665.description: Mother-to-child transmission accounts for most new hepatitis B (HBV) infections in high-burden regions globally. The World Health Organization recommends antiviral prophylaxis for pregnant women with high hepatitis B viral load levels, but access to viral load testing remains limited and untimely in many countries, due to centralized testing.

pmc-13224221.title: Endoscopic endonasal resection of transinfundibular craniopharyngiomas using a vertical infundibular split with subpial excavation: Case instruction and operative video
pmc-13224221.creator: Yusuke Morinaga, Takeshi Hongo, Sotaro Oshida, Shunsuke Shibao, Yasuhiro Tsunemi, Takashi Kashiwagi, Tsuguhisa Nakayama, Hiroyoshi Akutsu
pmc-13224221.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Radical resection of transinfundibular craniopharyngiomas (TCs) while preserving endocrine function remains a major surgical challenge because of their origin within the pituitary stalk. The “vertical infundibular split with subpial excavation” (VISSE) technique in endoscopic endonasal surgery (EES) is an effective approach that may enable gross total resection (GTR) in selected cases while aiming to preserve pituitary stalk integrity and neuroendocrine function.

pmc-13245376.title: Food insecurity in New York City college students during the COVID-19 pandemic: a longitudinal analysis of predictors, correlates, and trajectories
pmc-13245376.creator: Craig J Heck, Deborah A Theodore, April Autry, Brit Sovic, Cynthia Yang, Sarah Ann Anderson-Burnett, Caroline Ray, Eloise Austin, Joshua Rotbert, Jason Zucker, Marina Catallozzi, Magdalena E Sobieszczyk, Delivette Castor
pmc-13245376.description: Objective:To examine predictors, correlates, and trajectories of food insecurity (FI) among students during COVID-19.Participants:UndergraduatesMethods:Between 2020–2021, students completed quarterly (T1–T4) self-administered questionnaires. FI comprised food not lasting or not affording balanced meals. Trajectories were created using cumulative FI reports.Results:Across time, FI varied (T1 = 21%, T2 = 25%, T3 = 17%, T4 = 19%).
